description_en: Queries a list of data sources
name: ListConnections

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the data source belongs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据源所在的工作空间ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/178393.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source that you want to query
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

odps
mysql
rds
oss
sqlserver
polardb
oracle
mongodb
emr
postgresql
analyticdb_for_mysql
hybriddb_for_postgresql
holo
parameters.help_zh:
连接串的类型。常用类型枚举如下：
odps
mysql
rds
oss
sqlserver
polardb
oracle
mongodb
emr
postgresql
analyticdb_for_mysql
hybriddb_for_postgresql
holo
parameters.name: connection_type

parameters.help_en:
The subtype of the data source. This parameter is used in scenarios where a type includes subtypes. The following type and subtypes are supported:

Type: `rds`
Subtypes: `mysql`, `sqlserver`, and `postgresql`
parameters.help_zh:
连接串的子类型，针对某些父类型type中包含子类型的场景。目前有以下组合：
父类型：`rds`
子类型：`mysql`、 `sqlserver`或 `postgresql`
parameters.name: sub_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the data source. Valid values:

ENABLED
DISABLED
parameters.help_zh:
数据源的状态。
ENABLED 正常
DISABLED 禁用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The environment in which the data source is used. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates the development environment. The value 1 indicates the production environment
parameters.help_zh: 数据源所属的环境，包括0（开发环境）和1（生产环境）
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询页码。取值为大于等于1的正整数
parameters.name: page_number

Data.description_en: The query results for data sources that are returned on multiple pages
Data.description_zh: 连接串的分页查询结果

BindingCalcEngineId.description_en: The ID of the compute engine with which the data source is associated
BindingCalcEngineId.description_zh: 数据源关联的计算引擎ID

DefaultEngine.description_en: Indicates whether the compute engine that is associated with the data source is the default compute engine used by data sources of the same type
DefaultEngine.description_zh: 数据源关联的引擎是否为同类型下的默认引擎

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

EnvType.description_en:
The environment in which the data source is used. Valid values:

0: development environment
1: production environment
EnvType.description_zh:
数据源所在的环境。
0  开发环境
1 生产环境

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the data source was created. Example: Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM
GmtCreate.description_zh: 创建数据源的时间。时间格式示例为Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the data source was last modified. Example: Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM
GmtModified.description_zh: 修改数据源的时间。时间格式示例为Mar 17, 2021 4:09:32 PM

Name.description_en: The name of the data source

Operator.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to last modify the data source
Operator.description_zh: 最近一次修改数据源的阿里云用户ID

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace with which the data source is associated
ProjectId.description_zh: 数据源关联的工作空间ID

Sequence.description_en: The field that is used to sort data sources. Data sources are sorted in descending order based on the value of this parameter
Sequence.description_zh: 排序字段。数据源按此字段从大到小排序

Shared.description_en: Indicates whether the data source is a shared data source

Status.description_en:
The status of the data source. Valid values:

1: The data source is normal.
2: The data source is disabled
Status.description_zh:
数据源的状态。
1 正常
2 禁用

SubType.description_en:
The subtype of the data source. This parameter is used in scenarios where a type includes subtypes. The following type and subtypes are supported:

Type: `rds`
Subtypes: `mysql`, `sqlserver`, and `postgresql`
SubType.description_zh:
数据源的子类型。针对某些父类型type中包含子类型的场景。目前有以下组合：
父类型：`rds`
子类型：`mysql`、`sqlserver`或`postgresql`

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of data sources returned

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
